subject: School Facility Naming and Playground Fundraising
overview: The subcommittee drafted a new policy governing the naming and renaming of school facilities and deliberated on fundraising strategies for the upcoming McGlynn Elementary Playground project.

items.title: Draft School Facility Naming Policy
items.summary: Approved and referred a draft policy to the full School Committee that establishes authority and procedures for naming school buildings, grounds, and interior facilities. The policy was amended to clarify that the School Committee intends to support the recommendations of naming advisory committees whenever possible.

items.title: McGlynn Elementary Playground Participation Options
items.summary: Discussed fundraising models for the McGlynn Elementary Playground, favoring tiered donor recognition plaques and inclusive public art installations over naming individual pieces of play equipment. The chair will present a resolution to the full committee outlining donation thresholds to fund enhancements such as mature trees and bicycle racks.
